         1                 P R O C E E D I N G S

         2                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

         3       The Senate will please come to order.

         4                  I ask everyone present to rise and

         5       recite with me the Pledge of Allegiance to our

         6       Flag.

         7                  (Whereupon, the assemblage recited

         8       the Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag.)

         9                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        10       In the absence of clergy, may we all bow our

        11       heads for a moment of silence.

        12                  (Whereupon, the assemblage

        13       respected a moment of silence.)

        14                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        15       Thank you.

        16                  Senator Smith, I have at the desk

        17       here a proclamation which I'm handing down to

        18       the Secretary at this time.

        19                  The Secretary will read.

        20                  THE SECRETARY:    "Pursuant to the

        21       power vested in me by Article IV, Section 3 of

        22       the Constitution, I hereby convene the Senate

        23       of the State of New York in Extraordinary

        24       Session at the Capitol, in the City of Albany,



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         5443



         1       on the twenty-sixth day of June, two thousand

         2       nine, at twelve o'clock noon, for the purpose

         3       of considering legislation and nominations I

         4       will submit with respect to various subjects

         5       and for the consideration of legislation with

         6       respect to other subjects as I may recommend.

         7                  "Given under the hand and the privy

         8       seal of the State, in the City of Albany this

         9       twenty-fifth day of June in the year

        10       two thousand nine, by the Governor, David A.

        11       Paterson."

        12                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        13       The proclamation having been read, the session

        14       is in extraordinary session.

        15                  Senator Smith.

        16                  SENATOR SMITH:    Yes, Madam

        17       President.  I would just ask that we take a

        18       moment of silence for two people who have

        19       recently passed away, Michael Jackson and

        20       Farrah Fawcett.  If we can take a moment of

        21       silence for that, if our members will just

        22       stand.

        23                  (Whereupon, the assemblage

        24       respected a moment of silence.)



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.

         1                  SENATOR SMITH:    Madam President,

         2       again, for this fourth extraordinary session,

         3       at this time I would move, given that we still

         4       have the challenges before us, that we move to

         5       adjourn this session sine die.

         6                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

         7       Thank you, Senator.

         8                  On motion, this fourth

         9       extraordinary session is adjourned sine die.

        10                  (Whereupon, at 11:04 a.m., the

        11       Senate adjourned.)
